title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Avomi Cliq Bundle delivers exceptional value and performance, combining two complete Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kits with an additional Extra Pod. Designed for vapers who demand longevity and versatility, this bundle provides two high-capacity devices—each capable of delivering up to 6000 puffs, ensuring you have a reliable backup or the ability to rotate flavours instantly without carrying multiple pods. The Avomi Cliq leads the pack with its substantial 12ml hybrid system, which pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with a 10ml auto-refill container to ensure uninterrupted e-liquid flow. Powered by a robust 950mAh rechargeable battery, the device features a metallic soft-touch finish and an LED digital display to track battery life. Uniquely, the Cliq offers both Turbo and Normal modes, allowing you to switch between intense flavour production and extended battery efficiency. With advanced mesh coil technology and draw-activation, the Avomi Cliq provides a premium Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience. Each kit is preloaded with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid for a smooth and satisfying draw. Available Flavours: The Avomi Cliq is available in a diverse range of 10 flavours, catering to every palate. Options include refreshing fruit blends like Blueberry Ice and Watermelon Ice, zesty citrus profiles such as Lemon & Lime, and fizzy soda-inspired tastes like Cola Ice and Orange Soda. How To Set Up Your Avomi Cliq Device Step 1 Insert the 10ml refill container and 2ml pod into the device. Step 2 Allow the system to prime for a moment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape.
